events.text: Reference: The Sims build mode feel (4 images) but for the WHOLE city map, not a single lot. Decomposed: locked iso cam (rotate/zoom/floor up-down, top-right cluster) [IsoStage done]; cursor GHOST + green placement grid, click to place [new]; grid overlay on active floor [new]; cut-away walls to edit interiors [reuse cameraOcclusion/placedPieceCameraOccluders]; bottom catalog rail [reuse BUILD_CATALOG/prefabs]. Whole-map unbounded is the differentiator vs Sims lots.

STILL IN FLIGHT — paused for user decision. Foundation isoStage.ts built; full Sims-feel build recipe verified to the metal (screenRay→resolveSnapTarget→validatePlacement→session.commit on worldStream; cutaway via cameraOcclusion; groundColumnTop already exported from Embodied.tsx). One blocking decision surfaced: PlacedPieceMeshes renderer + its cluster (pieceVisualShapes/VisualShapeMesh/wallJoinSignature/BUILD_UI/occlusion) is LOCAL to the 2000-line PlayRoute. Recommended extracting it to editors/build/pieceMeshes.tsx (behavior-preserving, own commit) so F2 + iso share one renderer; alt is a lean second renderer (model still syncs via worldStream, only mesh code duplicates). Awaiting greenlight before touching the working F2 renderer.

Renderer extraction DONE + committed (c34ada30a); iso camera foundation committed (6fc242e4e). Next: build IsoAuthor.tsx pane (IsoStage + WorldStatics terrain + shared PlacedPieceMeshes + grid overlay + cursor ghost via resolveSnapTarget + click-commit to worldStream + floor/rotate/zoom controls + cutaway), then the bottom-right authoring-mode toggle in index.tsx.

Kept going down the list. Added (all in sync via worldStream, all bundle clean): terrain-following picks c99497492 (same groundColumnTop as F2); select+delete+clone 3f80055bd (raycastPieces + connected + pieceRemoved + piecePlaced-offset clone); cut-away walls 071f2cd65 (fade pieces above the active floor, the Sims view-this-level move). BLOCKER for the rest: wall SKINNING and SPAWNER/pathing placement both need NEW worldStream event kinds (a pieceSkinSet event; marker storage+events - WorldMarker is defined in build/markers.ts but not wired into worldStream; only legacy placements.ts has spawn/save markers). Adding stream events touches shared model + F2 + compile, not a unilateral fork - needs user's call. Roads = separate tile-based directional-grammar system (large). Iso pane core (place/select/edit/clone/cutaway/terrain) complete and additive.

resolution: Built the Sims-style whole-map build view: the bottom-right 3D pane now has an inspect|build toggle; build mode (IsoAuthor.tsx) is a locked iso camera over hmsc's real world — rotate in 90° detents (Q/E), zoom, grab-pan, floor up/down — where you pick a BUILD_CATALOG piece from the bottom rail and click the ground to place it, with a green/red cursor ghost previewing the snap. Matches the reference images' feel but unbounded across the whole city map, not a single lot. isoStage.ts is the pure iso camera (Isometric rig + unprojectGround + pieceRay). Verified the cart bundles clean (esbuild exit 0); camera uses the standard declarative Scene3D.Camera form. This is a FIRST WORKING SLICE for runtime feedback — remaining per the same vision: terrain-following picks (level 0 is flat y=0 for now), wall skinning, spawner markers, pathing routes, cloning, and cut-away walls.
